description.value: Tla-o-qui-aht Nation-owned resort on Pacific Rim Highway 3 km from Tofino, with exclusive access to tinwis Beach and full amenities including showers and laundry; only 5 tent sites among many RV hookups and cabins, so tent spots are scarce and advance reservations are critical.
